script:
$hermesDir = "C:\Users\E\AppData\Local\hermes"
$token = Get-Content "$env:TEMP\zen_token.txt" -Raw

"=== updating config.yaml ==="
$configPath = "$hermesDir\config.yaml"
$text = Get-Content $configPath -Raw

# Replace model section
$text = $text -replace 'default: "stealth/space-bunny-alpha"', 'default: "space-bunny-free"'
$text = $text -replace 'provider: "nous"', 'provider: "custom"'
$text = $text -replace 'base_url: "https://inference-api.nousresearch.com/v1"', 'base_url: "https://opencode.ai/zen/v1"'

$text | Out-File -FilePath $configPath -Encoding utf8
"Config updated"

"=== setting API key in .env ==="
$envPath = "$hermesDir\.env"
$envContent = ""
if (Test-Path $envPath) { $envContent = Get-Content $envPath -Raw }
# Remove old OPENAI_API_KEY if present, add new one
$envContent = ($envContent -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch "^OPENAI_API_KEY=" }) -join "`n"
$envContent += "`nOPENAI_API_KEY=$token`n"
$envContent | Out-File -FilePath $envPath -Encoding utf8
"API key set in .env"

"=== cleaning up temp token ==="
Remove-Item "$env:TEMP\zen_token.txt" -Force
"Done"

"=== verifying config ==="
Select-String -Path $configPath -Pattern 'default:|provider:|base_url:' | Select-Object Line | Select-Object -First 3
